acceptance_criteria.criterion: Navigating to #/repositories renders a table listing all repositories with ID, Name, and URL columns fetched from GET /api/repositories.
The 'Add Repository' form validates that URL is provided (required), accepts optional Name and ID fields, calls POST /api/repositories on submit, shows a success toast, and refreshes the table.
Inline edit functionality allows changing a repository's Name and persists the change via PUT /api/repositories/:id with body { name }.
Clicking Delete shows a confirmation dialog warning that the repo will be removed from all projects; confirming calls DELETE /api/repositories/:id and removes the row.
API errors during any CRUD operation are displayed as error toasts via showToast().
